content.text:
I changed `clone()` and `copy()` for meshes, lines and point clouds so the copy gets its own materials array. The materials inside the array are still shared, as the issue asks. I haven't run any tests or checked the change by hand.

The change is one line in each of the three files, in their `copy()` method (which `clone()` calls):

```js
this.material = Array.isArray( source.material ) ? source.material.slice() : source.material;
```

The files are `src/objects/Mesh.js`, `src/objects/Line.js` and `src/objects/Points.js`. An object with a single material behaves as before. I left `Sprite.js` alone because a sprite only ever has one material.
